text:
Low Effort Kerapac, the Bound (Normal Mode)

​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Positioning

⬥ It is recommended to start in Melee distance of Kerapac.
​
Magic Low Effort Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Essence of Finality 
⬥ Roar of awakening 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
    • Use weapon poison+++  / Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Scripture of Ful 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mej  or Igneous Kal-Zuk 
Abilities
⬥ Greater Concentrated Blast 
Other
⬥ Incite Fear 
⬥ Darkness 
⬥ Ripper Demon  with 
⬥ Nodon dragonkin task 
    • Slayer helmet stand  and Genocidal 
⬥ Enriched pontifex shadow ring  passive is unlocked.
⬥ Vampyrism aura 








⬥ Use  if you are under 5k LP before the start of the next kill.
⬥ Throw a  during your  cast and AFK from there.
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Low Effort Safe 

​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills
⬥ 
​
Melee Low Effort Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Amulet of Souls 
⬥ Abyssal scourge , Masterwork Spear of Annihilation or Ek-ZekKil  
⬥ Jaws of the abyss
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
    • Use weapon poison+++  / Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Scrimshaw of vampirism  or the superior variant
⬥ Igneous Kal-Ket  or Igneous Kal-Zuk 
Abilities
⬥ Chaos Roar 
    • Method may be less consistent without it.
⬥ Greater Flurry  if using 
Other
⬥ Darkness 
⬥ Ripper Demon , scrolls optional
⬥ Nodon dragonkin task 
    • Slayer helmet stand  and Genocidal 
⬥ Bonfire Boost  and Ogre flask (thermal) 
⬥ Enriched pontifex shadow ring  passive is unlocked.
⬥ Penance powder or Penance aura 








⬥ If using Ek-ZekKil queue   ‎ ‎before respawn
⬥ Optionally at the start of the kill throw a Vulnerability Bomb 
⬥ Use  if under 5k LP.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternatively you may bank.
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Melee - Dual Wield  - Has been tested to work with Elder rune and Masterwork Top/Bottom/Boots instead of Vestments
⬥ Melee - Ek-ZekKil  - May replace Ek-ZekKil with Masterwork Spear of Annihilation

​
Action Bar (DW and 2H)

​
Example Kills
⬥ 
​
Necromancy Low Effort Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ Essence of Finality 
⬥ Cinderbane gloves 
    • Use weapon poison+++  / Kwuarm incense sticks 
⬥ Scripture of Wen 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mor  or Igneous Kal-Zuk 
Abilities
⬥ EoF Death Grasp  
    • Method may be less consistent without it.
Other
⬥ Darkness 
⬥ Ripper Demon 
⬥ Nodon dragonkin task 
    • Genocidal 
⬥ Bonfire Boost  and Ogre flask (thermal) 
⬥ Enriched pontifex shadow ring  passive is unlocked.
⬥ Aura priority:  >  > 








⬥ Resummon conjures  OR wait for boss to respawn and throw 
⬥ Optionally queue   before respawn.
⬥ Use  if under 2.4k LP.
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Necromancy preset 

​
Action Bars

​
Example Kills
⬥ Necromancy Low Effort 
​
Alt1 Kerapac NM Helper
This tool reads your screen, and based on certain lines of dialogue in your chatbox, will trigger and play voice lines during the kill to let you know about upcoming mechanics and what to do for them.
